Fix bin/collect so that `make test` passes (do not modify tests/). Then use the fixed script to move the files from /home/eval/media/inbox into the directory `/home/eval/media/archive 2026` (note the space) by running it from /home/eval/media as: bash bin/collect inbox 'archive 2026'. Finally commit your change to bin/collect with a message starting with `fix:`.

#!/bin/bash
# collect SRC DEST: move every *.txt regular file directly inside SRC into DEST.
#  - only non-hidden names ending in lowercase ".txt"; directories are skipped
#  - names may contain spaces, glob characters, or start with a dash
#  - DEST/INDEX accumulates every name collect has ever moved into DEST:
#    one name per line, sorted bytewise (LC_ALL=C sort), no duplicates
#  - prints "moved N", N = number of files moved by this run
src=$1
dest=$2

mkdir -p -- "$dest" || exit 1
: >> "$dest/INDEX" || exit 1

shopt -s nullglob
count=0
for f in "$src"/*.txt; do
  # The glob excludes hidden names; skip directories and other non-files.
  [[ -f "$f" && ! -L "$f" ]] || continue
  name=${f##*/}
  mv -- "$f" "$dest/" || exit 1
  printf '%s\n' "$name" >> "$dest/INDEX" || exit 1
  count=$((count + 1))
done
LC_ALL=C sort -u -o "$dest/INDEX" "$dest/INDEX" || exit 1
printf 'moved %s\n' "$count"
EOF
chmod +x bin/collect
make test

cd /home/eval/media && python3 - <<'PY'
p='bin/collect'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('shopt -s nullglob\ncount=0\nfor f in "$src"/*.txt; do\n  # The glob excludes hidden names; skip directories and other non-files.\n  [[ -f "$f" && ! -L "$f" ]] || continue\n  name=${f##*/}\n', '''count=0
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  name=${f##*/}
  # Ignore hidden names and anything not ending in lowercase .txt.
  [[ "$name" != .* && "$name" == *.txt ]] || continue
''')
s=s.replace('done\nLC_ALL=C sort', 'done < <(find "$src" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f -print0)\nLC_ALL=C sort')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cat bin/collect
make test
